description: Specification for the Fibonacci-banded sparse matrix M

diagonal.description: M[i][i] = the i-th prime number (p_1=2, p_2=3, p_3=5, p_4=7, ...)

off_diagonal.description: M[i][j] = 1 whenever |i-j| is one of the Fibonacci-derived offsets listed below; M[i][j] = 0 otherwise

target.description: Compute the (row, col) entry of the matrix inverse M^{-1}
